Hello Gizzo, i am a follower of your journal, that i discovered recently, after i've gone through several others amazing in RTM. I noticed you are part of the ones who make good trading a "simple thing"....or at least looking like!!, and i have a huge consideration for anything successful appearing simple and clear, because generally speaking the truth is like this, always in this world. I also think simplicity and clarity aren't gifts, but only can come from hard work, and from the magic thing called "method".

Now the subject of my post: i see your trades seems to be frequent, on several pairs/crosses, often in midranges, with no special search for "key levels", no special zones more suitable for trading plans in each chart (pls correct me if i'm wrong). noticed most of the profitable setups in the market occur simultaneously in many pairs/crosses, and they really allow not more than few seconds to decide opening profitable positions. So i mean many good setups go missed everyday without methods allowing controls continuous on many charts contemporary My question: do you watch contemporary many pairs, or you just select daily a narrow group of pairs to be watched continuously in your daily session? Thank you very much, and my congrats!!

Thank you so much altoufx

Well, thats the hardest part about trading I think, making it simple. I try not to overcomplicate things and I dont care about massive moves and overanalyze where price is heading.... Im here to make money and as long as I do that with consistency Im more than happy

Back to answering about the question I usually use pending orders. I monitor all the major pairs and to the most common crosses. I analyze the market on the weekends for a weekly baise. Marking out important HTF areas. Thats pretty much it. Simple stuff
